note: Registry for build-place-terrain.mjs. bbox is [W,S,E,N] in degrees, sized ~15-30 km per side around the place's signature terrain. dem_zoom 13 = ~15-19 m/sample at temperate latitudes (~2-4 MB heights.bin); tex_zoom = dem_zoom+1 doubles texture resolution (~1-3 MB JPEG). Keep each place's total under ~20 MB (operator budget 2026-08-28). cloud_lt = max Sentinel-2 cloud cover percent accepted.

places.name: Grand Canyon (South Rim + river core)
places.notes: Pilot 1. Window centered on Bright Angel / South Rim; river visible at ~750 m, rim ~2100 m - use these as decode sanity checks.

places.name: Mount Everest (Khumbu massif)
places.notes: Pilot 2. Summit 86.9253E 27.9881N, 8849 m. Himalaya scenes are often cloudy/snowy - cloud_lt relaxed; prefer a post-monsoon (Oct-Dec) scene if the top STAC hit looks poor.

places.name: Mount Fuji (stratovolcano + Fuji Five Lakes edge)
places.notes: Pilot 3. Summit 138.7274E 35.3606N, 3776 m. Near-perfect radial cone - the strongest visual proof that real DEM beats procedural noise.

places.name: Mammoth Cave (karst plateau surface over the cave system)
places.notes: Surface-karst mode (runbook guard 8): this is the SURFACE terrain of the sinkhole plain / karst plateau above the cave system, not the cave interior (which stays a schematic toggle). Centered on the Mammoth Cave Visitor Center (37.1862N 86.1000W, ~230m/755ft) with the Green River valley cutting across the window (~128m/420ft at Green River Ferry) - use these as decode sanity checks. Relief here is gentle (sinkhole plain + river valley), not a peak.
